title: Measurement Artifacts in Trustworthiness Evaluations of Quantized Small Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.32848v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluations of quantized language models attribute the change in a benchmark score to quantization. We write the measured change as the true change plus a term contributed by the instrument. Instrument error that is the same at every precision can shrink a paired comparison but cannot create or reverse an effect. Error that interacts with quantization can do both, and it is reported as an effect of quantization. We estimate this interaction for four measurement choices in 8 instruction-tuned models below two billion parameters, at float16, LLM.int8() and NF4, on identical items. Measured against labels from two human annotators, the 4-bit rise in harmful compliance is about half to two-thirds of the rise in non-refusal that a corrected key word detector records. Cloze and lettered multiple-choice scoring disagree about the effect of quantization far more than their noise allows: their estimates correlate at \r{ho} = 0.10, against a ceili

translated_title: 量化小型语言模型可信度评估中的测量伪影
translated_abstract: 对量化语言模型的评估通常将基准分数的变化归因于量化。我们将测量到的变化表示为真实变化加上由测量工具贡献的一项。在每种精度下都相同的测量工具误差只会缩小配对比较的结果，但无法制造或逆转效应；而与量化发生交互作用的误差则两者皆可做到，并且会被当作量化的效应报告出来。我们在8个参数量低于20亿的指令微调模型上，于float16、LLM.int8()和NF4三种精度下使用相同题目，估计了四种测量选择下这种交互作用的大小。以两名人类标注者的标签为参照，4比特量化导致的有害顺从上升约为经过修正的关键词检测器所记录的非拒绝上升的一半至三分之二。完形填空式与字母选项式选择题评分在量化效应上的分歧远超其噪声水平所允许的范围：两者的估计值相关性仅为 ρ = 0.10，而理论上限……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了量化语言模型可信度评估中与量化交互作用的测量误差会被误报为量化效应，并实证发现4比特量化导致的有害顺从上升仅为关键词检测器记录的非拒绝上升的一半至三分之二，且不同评分方法对量化效应的估计严重不一致。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that measurement errors interacting with quantization get misreported as quantization effects in trustworthiness evaluations, finding that the 4-bit rise in harmful compliance is only half to two-thirds of the rise in non-refusal recorded by a corrected keyword detector, while different scoring methods yield highly inconsistent estimates of the quantization effect.
